name: DogWifTools
rootCause: DogWifTools, a Windows-based toolkit for Solana meme coin projects, suffered a supply-chain compromise in late January 2025. Attackers used a stolen GitHub token to push trojanized updates containing a RAT, which harvested wallet and exchange credentials and drained user funds valued at over $10 million. No chain-level theft or recipient addresses have been published. DogWifTools failed to protect a privileged GitHub credential used for software update distribution. Attackers obtained the token and replaced official Windows update builds (v1.6.3,1.6.6) with RAT-infected versions, allowing automated theft of wallet keys and exchange account credentials from users’ systems.…
